approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 executable on the ReXGlue SDK, Xenos GPU emulated on the host
notes: Native PC port of Crackdown (2007). Public beta: title screen, menus and the open city are playable, 60 fps by default (stock 30 fps optional), controller input, a launcher, and System Link co-op (30 fps). No game data is included; you supply your own copy of the game. Next: higher resolutions and frame rates, in-game PC options, then an Archipelago randomizer.
